_note: Differential-drive goal reaching. 10 Hz policy = 5 physics steps of 20 ms. Wheel velocity targets up to 10 rad/s (0.05 m wheels -> 0.5 m/s). Goals 1-2.5 m from the spawn point. Episodes run their full length (terminate_on_reach false) so the policy learns to hold the goal; base_reached then pays every step inside 0.15 m. Success = inside the radius at the end of the episode; early stop at 90% over the last 200 episodes. obs_noise (std on raw values) makes the policy tolerate the deployed loop's observation age and ground-truth jitter.
